Name: Stereo Image Segment Data
Description: This TRE contains DPPDB stereo segment model data. It is a user-defined file included in the data extension subheader. All fields are repeated for each segment model.

SISEGID.Name: Segment Model ID
SISEGID.Description: This field indicates the ID of the DPPDB segment model.

SNACE.Name: Segment Absolute CE90
SNACE.Description: This field indicates the segment absolute circular error at 90% confidence.

SNALE.Name: Segment Absolute LE90
SNALE.Description: This field indicates the segment absolute linear error at 90% confidence.

SNMCE.Name: Segment Mensuration (1 pixel) CE90
SNMCE.Description: This field indicates the segment mensuration circular error (1 pixel) at 90% confidence.

SNMLE.Name: Segment Mensuration (1 pixel) LE90
SNMLE.Description: This field indicates the segment mensuration linear error (1 pixel) at 90% confidence.

EXACERF.Name: Exceeds Absolute CE Rqmt Flag
EXACERF.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the absolute CE requirement flag.

EXALERF.Name: Exceeds Absolute LE Rqmt Flag
EXALERF.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the absolute LE requirement flag.

SNRCE0_1.Name: Segment Relative CEP (0-1 nm), (50%)
SNRCE0_1.Description: This field indicates the segment relative CEP (0-1 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRLE0_1.Name: Segment Relative LEP (0-1 nm), (50%)
SNRLE0_1.Description: This field indicates the segment relative LEP (0-1 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRCE1_5.Name: Segment Relative CEP (1-5 nm), (50%)
SNRCE1_5.Description: This field indicates the segment relative CEP (1-5 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRLE1_5.Name: Segment Relative LEP (1-5 nm), (50%)
SNRLE1_5.Description: This field indicates the segment relative LEP (1-5 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRCE5_15.Name: Segment Relative CEP (5-15 nm), (50%)
SNRCE5_15.Description: This field indicates the segment relative CEP (5-15 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRLE5_15.Name: Segment Relative LEP (5-15 nm), (50%)
SNRLE5_15.Description: This field indicates the segment relative LEP (5-15 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRCE15_30.Name: Segment Relative CEP (15-30 nm), (50%)
SNRCE15_30.Description: This field indicates the segment relative CEP (15-30 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRLE15_30.Name: Segment Relative LEP (15-30 nm), (50%)
SNRLE15_30.Description: This field indicates the segment relative LEP (15-30 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRCE30.Name: Segment Relative CEP (>30 nm), (50%)
SNRCE30.Description: This field indicates the segment relative CEP (>30 nm) at 50% confidence.

SNRLE30.Name: Segment Relative LEP (>30 nm), (50%)
SNRLE30.Description: This field indicates the segment relative LEP (>30 nm) at 50% confidence.

EXRCE0_1.Name: Exceeds Relative CEP (0-1 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRCE0_1.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative CEP (0-1 nm) requirement flag.

EXRLE0_1.Name: Exceeds Relative LEP (0-1 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRLE0_1.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative LEP (0-1 nm) requirement flag.

EXRCE1_5.Name: Exceeds Relative CEP (1-5 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRCE1_5.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative CEP (1-5 nm) requirement flag.

EXRLE1_5.Name: Exceeds Relative LEP (1-5 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRLE1_5.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative LEP (1-5 nm) requirement flag.

EXRCE5_15.Name: Exceeds Relative CEP (5-15 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRCE5_15.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative CEP (5-15 nm) requirement flag.

EXRLE5_15.Name: Exceeds Relative LEP (5-15 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRLE5_15.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative LEP (5-15 nm) requirement flag.

EXRCE15_30.Name: Exceeds Relative CEP (15-30 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRCE15_30.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative CEP (15-30 nm) requirement flag.

EXRLE15_30.Name: Exceeds Relative LEP (15-30 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRLE15_30.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative LEP (15-30 nm) requirement flag.

EXRCE30.Name: Exceeds Relative CEP (>30 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRCE30.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative CEP (>30 nm) requirement flag.

EXRLE30.Name: Exceeds Relative LEP (>30 nm) Rqmt Flag
EXRLE30.Description: This field indicates whether the segment exceeds the relative LEP (>30 nm) requirement flag.
